C0231.title: Manmankan App Shared Youku Memberships and Was Ordered to Pay RMB 2 Million for Unfair Competition
C0231.summary: In August 2019, Beijing Internet Court heard Youku’s case against Beijing Manlan Technology. Manlan charged users in the “Manmankan” App for access to Youku VIP content through a shared-membership model. The court held that the conduct did not constitute direct infringement of the right of communication through information networks, but violated good faith and internet-industry business ethics, constituted unfair competition, and ordered RMB 2 million in economic losses and reasonable expenses.
